purpose: Teach: シーア/難関/人民元/ウイグル/最高峰/浙江/広州/天空

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、中東イスラーム派閥でシーア派の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered Shia scholarship in the Middle East for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious. Soft opening. Leaning forward slightly with interest. The tone of a teacher who's actually read the work and wants to hear him talk about it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、最難関大学入試研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about university entrance exam research.
lines.style: Quiet, a little tense. Eyes slightly down. Speaking carefully, as if correcting something unspoken. Precise but not defensive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、人民元の国際化を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote about the internationalization of the yuan for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle curiosity, not accusation. Watching him closely. The tone of someone noticing a pattern and wondering why.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ウイグル自治区の経済を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about economic development in Xinjiang.
lines.style: Quiet and direct. Brief. A small note of strain underneath — he knows what this looks like. Not apologetic but aware.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 世界最高峰の山岳研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered world-leading mountain research for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Bright, encouraging tone. Leaning in with genuine interest. A beat of warmth — trying to connect with him over the work itself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、浙江省の経済発展を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about economic development in Zhejiang Province.
lines.style: Flat, resigned. Eyes away. The third time now. Speaking faster, shorter. There's nowhere left to hide this.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、広州の貿易拠点研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered Guangzhou's role as a trade hub for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Slower now. Quieter. Not aggressive but searching. The teacher's voice when she's putting pieces together and doesn't like the picture.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、天空望遠鏡の観測史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the observation history of the sky telescope.
lines.style: Small, tired. The last answer. He's given up trying to make it match. Looking at his hands. Waiting for the consequence.
